rows: Session.trust_env controls environment proxy, authentication and related settings.
A pinned network client must explicitly choose and receipt this policy.
stream=True defers body download until content is consumed.
Applications still need pre-read and aggregate byte ceilings.
Requests documents that trust_env=False disables netrc use.
Official-source sessions should not silently inherit ambient credentials.
WCS 2.0.1 defines GetCapabilities, DescribeCoverage, CoverageId, axis labels and coverage descriptions.
Clients must bind responses to the requested coverage and service version.
The official test suite validates mandatory conformance classes and referenced XML schemas.
Parsing well-formed XML alone is not conformance validation.
OGC publishes WCS standards and encoding resources.
The implementation must pin the exact version and extensions it relies on.
all_touched=False selects pixel centres or Bresenham-selected pixels and filled=False returns a masked array.
Mask semantics and dataset nodata still require explicit validation.
Dataset objects expose band count, dtypes and affine transform information.
CRS alone does not establish a valid elevation raster schema.
Rasterio exposes dtypes, scales, offsets, transform, count and nodata metadata.
Elevation values require these fields to be bound to the measurement contract.
Rasterio documents per-dataset and per-band validity masks.
A missing nodata value can imply all pixels valid and must not be assumed equivalent to verified coverage validity.
rasterio.transform.xy supports explicit centre offsets for pixel coordinates.
Pixel-centre alignment must be checked against the requested subset and polygon.
MemoryFile opens raster bytes from an in-memory buffer.
The full buffer must be bounded before it is created.
numpy.quantile computes quantiles over the supplied flattened values by default.
Input validity and ordering contracts remain the caller's responsibility.
A masked array combines data with a validity mask.
The origin and semantics of that mask must be verified.
NumPy provides operations for masked and invalid values.
A project-specific nodata and finite-value policy is still required.
Shapely exposes is_valid to test geometry validity.
Non-empty polygon type alone does not prove validity.
Shapely guidance recommends is_valid for thorough geometry checks.
Parsing or constructing geometry is not equivalent to validating it.
subprocess.run supports timeout and documents child termination and waiting behavior.
A process-tree policy is still required for descendants.
os.replace can atomically replace a destination under supported filesystem conditions.
Durability and generation binding require additional flush and manifest steps.
Temporary-file helpers create unique temporary files securely.
The temp file must remain on the intended volume and inside the authorized root.
The official dataset is DTM 1 m in EPSG:27700, metres ODN and reports ±0.15 m RMSE.
Fresh WCS bytes and raster schema still require direct receipts.
The current INSPIRE package is published monthly and provides authority archives.
Catalogue availability does not prove exact downloaded GML bytes.
Terrain 50 uses 200 by 200 cells, 50 m spacing and 10 km tiles.
It remains a secondary coarse crosscheck rather than the 1 m primary metric.
HTTP defines representation metadata including media type and content length semantics.
Clients must still enforce redirect, encoding and aggregate-size policies.
